nom: SOME BY MI AHA BHA PHA 30 Day Miracle Exfoliating Cica Toner Pads

avis.texte: Leaves a oily fillm residue over my face not worth the price does not do what is says
Do not recommend for sensitive skin, damaged the skin around my jawline/lower cheeks. BUT it definitely exfoliated so i would recommend for those who do not have sensitive skin

These are great toner pads, they have really cleared my skin up. But ive noticed some acne along my chin and jawline, which i never usually get. Although, im pretty sure its because ive been eating sugar recently, but just keep in mind to watch out for that overall area. I have oily-acne prone skin and these little pads worked wonders for me. Also the scent is quite stong.

avis.titre: Watch out for the tea tree.
avis.texte: This product was going really good at first getting rid of my texture. But now my chin looks really bad so im not purchasing this anymore!

These pads literally were a turning point in my skin care routine! If you have severely sensitive or acne prome skin, I highly recommend this product to help combat the irritation, inflammation, redness, etc. that comes with fighting acne. These pads keep my overall redness down and oiliness down as well. I switch off ever other day with my tret and had no issues with purging.
I use this product on my face at night just before going to bed and wake up with very glowy skin!!

I have combination/acne/sensitive skin. My face was so congested for the past 2 and a half months...I couldn't get rid of the acne/closed comedones on my cheeks and chin until I used this! It was so gentle on my skin it didn't cause any irritation. I've been using it for a week and a half and ive seen a huge difference. The bha/aha really do exfoliate your skin but it isn't harsh like others. If your skin is sensitive like mine give this a try!

avis.titre: I will be repurchasing this product for KP
avis.texte: For the 10 years I had been looking for a good exfoliant that was strong but non irritating and this product is just that!! I applied it on my arms for 2 weeks and my texture and hyperpigmentation from KP have dramatically improved.

Bought these to help with minor texture on my forehead. 30 days later... the texture is visibly worse and it has broken me out. My forehead, chin and my cheeks are all breaking out because of this product. Was super excited to try it, but super let down.

avis.titre: Dark Spot and Ingrown Hair Friendly
avis.texte: I have some texture and ingrown issues and the AHA and BHA is some of the only things I've tried that is strong enough to remove dead skin but gentle enough to not burn me! I use it on my face and any problem areas on the body - will be buying more.

Been using twice a day after washing my face for about 2 weeks. I'm 34 with large pores and combination skin. This product has visibly reduced my pores and helped with age spots. Obsessed is an understatement!!
This is the only product that has actually cleared my skin, i will continue to repurchase as it keeps my pimples at bay
I love these. My skin looks amazing and the pre soaked pads are so convenient! Will be my go to now!
My skin texture has definitely improved since I started using these!
Quick yet maintained results from a non-toxic and affordable product. Literally nothing compares to this. I highly recommend!

avis.titre: Works for evening skin texture due to congested pores
avis.texte: These are great! I have only used the pads for 4 days (daily after cleansing) and I'm already seeing results. My skin is smoother, brighter, less congested, and less oily. I'm in my mid-40s and still deal with acne. But unlike in my teens/20s/30s when my skin was just always an oil slick, I have both dryness and oiliness at the same time now. Finding the right balance for oil control and anti-aging is tricky. After using these pads, my skin feels balanced and soft, and not too dried out. I love that they include a small set of tweezers in the cap of the product to keep the product sanitary. There is a slight fragrance from the tea tree oil and peppermint oil, which doesn't bother me, and smells rather refreshing.
